sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, and face an Alsager side struggling near the bottom of the division on just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to build on recent consistency. AFC Bridgnorth, sitting third on 19 points, host Eccleshall in a clash of two strong performers—Eccleshall unbeaten in their last four but having lost their previous fixture. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points in fourth, face a struggling Wednesfield Community side at home. In-form Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) visit Foley Meir, while Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a meeting of mid-table teams. New Mills, on poor recent form with two losses in their last three, travel to face Market Drayton Town, who are also seeking consistency. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a basement-area clash, and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's lowest-ranked sides. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's bottom club on just 2 points.
